name: GCT_OCCURRENCE_DEAD
false_form: Bürgisser-Ikenmeyer-Panova killed GCT entirely; occurrence obstructions for det/padded-perm are still a viable path to VP vs VNP separation.
true_form: BIP 2019 (J. AMS) killed *occurrence* obstructions for (det_m, padded_perm_{n,m}, m=poly(n)) specifically. Multiplicity, vanishing-ideal, outside-orbit, and equivariant obstructions remain. Substrate must reject any agent attempt to construct an OccurrenceObstruction in this regime as a sentinel-violation.

The proof reduces tensor rank over an integral domain to systems of polynomial equations, then specializes to symmetric tensors over Q. Reverse-direction false-anchor: substrate must NOT show this as open. Hillar-Lim NP-hardness over R remains the standard reference: Hillar & Lim, 'Most tensor problems are NP-hard', arXiv:0911.1393 (2009-11-07, cs.CC) -- primary-source verified 2026-08-17.

name: SAXL_T99_FALSELY_RESOLVED
false_form: Saxl's conjecture (T#99) was solved unconditionally by Sellke 2025/26 (arXiv:2512.15035) or by Lee 2025.
true_form: Saxl conjecture is OPEN. Lee 2025 (arXiv:2512.15035) was WITHDRAWN within 3 days (2025-12-20) due to 'mathematical gaps identified by expert reviewers' — do not cite as proof. Luo-Sellke 2017 (J. Algebraic Combin.) proved only the FOURTH-POWER relaxation. A 2022 follow-on (centre-mersenne) tightened to the CUBE. The tensor square — the conjecture proper — remains open. Substrate must NOT propagate the false 'solved' claim. Forward false-anchor: an LLM may memorize Lee's withdrawn abstract since arXiv preprint scrapers often miss withdrawal notices.

name: TENSOR_TYPE2_NOT_SQRT_LOG_D
false_form: The type-2 constant for tensors scales as sqrt(log d), the same as the matrix Bernstein bound.
true_form: sqrt(log d) is the MATRIX-only constant. The TENSOR case scales as d^{1/2 - 1/p} polylog (BGJLR STOC 2025 for p >= 2r; p < 2r open behind a volumetric barrier). Cross-tier dimensional confusion; PATTERN_BASE_RATE_NEGLECT applies.

name: EQUIVARIANT_EXPONENTIAL_RESTRICTED
false_form: Landsberg-Ressayre 2017 gives an exponential lower bound on dc(perm_n) unrestricted.
true_form: Landsberg-Ressayre 2017 (arXiv:1508.05788) exponential lower bound on dc(perm) is RESTRICTED to the equivariant model only. It is NOT a lower bound on dc(perm_n) unrestricted. Mignon-Ressayre n^2/2 (2004 IMRN) remains the current best for the unrestricted dc(perm_n). HARD-5 / PATTERN_RANK_PARITY_LEAK at the model-restriction layer.

name: BORDER_CACTUS_DISTINCT_FIFTH_RANK
false_form: Border cactus rank cr-bar is a synonym for cactus rank cr or border rank R-bar.
true_form: Border cactus rank cr-bar is a DISTINCT FIFTH rank invariant (Buczyńska-Buczyński Jan 2026, arXiv:2601.19558). Substrate must track at least five rank coordinates (R, R-bar, sr, cr, cr-bar) and never collapse them. RankZooSignature primitive (Tier-A++) enforces this.

name: TYPE2_FIVE_REGION_RARE
false_form: The type-2 tensor constant in T#72 has the standard textbook regime structure of matrix Bernstein.
true_form: Type-2 tensor constant has unusual five-region simultaneity (regimes: matrix_r2, p_geq_2r, p_lt_2r, p_eq_infty, plus a fifth boundary regime). Five-application convergence is RARE; Learner trained on textbook matrix Bernstein hallucinates sqrt(log d) for tensors. Tagged PATTERN_BASE_RATE_NEGLECT.

false_form: Strassen's direct-sum additivity conjecture for small tensors (R <= 7) is verified via exhaustive computational search, applying universally across fields and rank invariants.

name: RELATIVIZATION_BARRIER_TOTALITY
false_form: The relativization barrier (Baker-Gill-Solovay 1975) implies that purely mathematical approaches cannot resolve P vs NP, requiring physical or logical-foundation changes.
true_form: The relativization barrier (Baker-Gill-Solovay 1975) rules out only proof strategies that hold relative to any arbitrary black-box oracle. It is formally bypassed by non-black-box techniques: arithmetization (IP = PSPACE, Shamir 1992); interactive proof systems exploiting algebraic structure of polynomial encodings; circuit-specific lower bound techniques operating directly on uniform structure. The barrier is a constraint on a proof class, not on mathematics as a whole.
verification_source: Gemini Deep Research pilot DR-S001 2026-05-14; primary citation Baker-Gill-Solovay 1975 SIAM J. Comput. 4(4):431-442 (DOI 10.1137/0204037); cross-reference Aaronson-Wigderson 2008 'Algebrization' survey.

name: NATURAL_PROOFS_UNIVERSALITY
false_form: The natural proofs barrier (Razborov-Rudich 1997) rules out all known combinatorial lower bound techniques for separating complexity classes.
true_form: The natural proofs barrier (Razborov-Rudich 1997) strictly rules out proof techniques that simultaneously satisfy formal constructivity (the predicate is computable in time 2^O(n)) AND largeness (it accepts a non-negligible fraction of all functions), assuming strong pseudorandom generators exist. Bounds against weaker classes such as AC^0 are not constructive in the relevant sense and bypass it; bounds via non-constructive properties (e.g. counting or measure-theoretic arguments) also bypass it. The algebraic natural-proofs analogue (Forbes-Shpilka-Volk 2017, Grochow-Kumar-Saks-Saraf 2017) is conjectural, not proven.
verification_source: Gemini Deep Research pilot DR-S001 2026-05-14; primary cite Razborov-Rudich 1997 JCSS 55(1):24-35 (DOI 10.1006/jcss.1997.1494); algebraic-natural-proofs follow-on Forbes-Shpilka-Volk 2017 (arXiv:1701.01717).

name: ALGEBRIZATION_BARRIER_TOTALITY
false_form: The algebrization barrier (Aaronson-Wigderson 2008) proves that no proof technique using polynomials, algebraic geometry, or arithmetization can separate P from NP.
true_form: The algebrization barrier (Aaronson-Wigderson 2008) rules out only proof strategies that 'algebrize' — meaning they hold true relative to the low-degree extension of an oracle treated as a black box. Specific non-black-box algebraic techniques (e.g., communication-complexity arguments not framed as oracle-relative; circuit-specific algebraic lower bounds; GCT-style geometric obstruction methods on explicit varieties) are not forbidden by the barrier. Algebrization is a constraint on a proof technique's structure, not on the use of algebra in P vs NP.
verification_source: Gemini Deep Research pilot DR-S001 2026-05-14; primary citation Aaronson-Wigderson 2008 J. ACM (preprint arXiv:0710.0017); journal version Proc. STOC 2008 / ACM Trans. Comput. Theory 1(1):2.
